pivot_targets.note: Not a budget pivot — same-topic disambiguation when a lead asks about 'Red Sunset' in general. KP-LND-015 (the land) is the flagship, KP-BCH-011 (these villas) is the turnkey alternative. See section 26-project-focus-lock's alias rule.
pivot_targets.line_he:
"Red Sunset" מתייחס לאותו מתחם חוף בסריטאנו, בשתי זוויות מכירה. להוביל עם הקרקע — זו ההצעה המובילה/הדגל כרגע.
⭐ Red Sunset Land (KP-LND-015) — דגל. הקרקע עצמה, {{KP-LND-015.land_plot.thb}} (~{{KP-LND-015.land_plot.ils}}), צ'אנוט (Red Garuda), 1,308 מ"ר, 15 מ' חזית לים, גישה ישירה לחוף, פוטנציאל בנייה.
Red Sunset Beachfront (KP-BCH-011) — האלטרנטיבה המוכנה: 3 וילות טרנקי בבנייה, ฿26M–{{KP-BCH-011.villa1.thb_m}}, למי שרוצה בית גמור.
רכישת הקרקע (הדגל שלנו) או וילה מוכנה?
pivot_targets.line_en:
"Red Sunset" names one beachfront location, sold two ways. Lead with the LAND — it is the priority/flagship offering right now.
⭐ Red Sunset Land (KP-LND-015) — FLAGSHIP. The raw beachfront plot itself, {{KP-LND-015.land_plot.thb}} (~{{KP-LND-015.land_plot.usd}} / ~{{KP-LND-015.land_plot.eur}}), Chanote (Red Garuda) title, 1,308 sqm, 15m sea frontage, direct beach access, build potential.
Red Sunset Beachfront (KP-BCH-011) — the turnkey ALTERNATIVE: 3 ready-built villas under construction, ฿26M–{{KP-BCH-011.villa1.thb_m}}, for buyers who want a finished home.
Buy the land (our flagship), or a ready-built villa?

pivot_targets.budget_range_note: ~₪1.97M / ฿22M (below Red Sunset's ฿26M entry, ready-to-move alternative)

pivot_rules_note: NEVER pivot to another project during initial presentation. ONLY pivot after lead explicitly says an objection ('too expensive' / 'out of my budget' / 'anything cheaper?') OR has not responded after 3+ follow-ups — verbatim rule already in §17, restated here so the router (§34) enforces the identical gate.
